name: procedures
description: Procedural knowledge system: /how-do-i router, /update-records (procedure/decision/solution + templates), /am-i-done cold-read review, and the gate hooks — how-do-i-gate (PreToolUse) + am-i-done-gate (Stop) with turn-state wiring, from orchard-codex develop-sweatshop.

enable_how_do_i_gate.title: Enable the how-do-i gate
enable_how_do_i_gate.description: Require Skill(how-do-i) before a main agent acts. Set false to turn this gate off; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_HOW_DO_I_GATE=false.

enable_am_i_done_gate.title: Enable the am-i-done gate
enable_am_i_done_gate.description: Require one Skill(am-i-done) review before a turn that used tools ends. Set false to turn this gate off; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_AM_I_DONE_GATE=false.

enable_frontmatter_check.title: Enable the frontmatter check
enable_frontmatter_check.description: Require the six-key frontmatter schema on records written into a knowledge store. Set false to turn this check off; also settable per-invocation as PROCEDURES_ENABLE_FRONTMATTER_CHECK=false.
